d:
It is so easy to get pulled into noise. Thoughts, expectations, pressure, the constant feeling of needing to do more, to become something else.
But in the moments we pause, when we simply sit with the silence & just listen to our breath, we come home. In those moments nothing is missing.
Calm isn’t something we have to earn or reach.
It’s already here, underneath everything, waiting for us to soften into it.
Slow down. Listen.
